messages:
zoe (People Ops): Quick Q  we had a mid-year 401(k) recordkeeper fee increase that applied during our vendor cutover window. An employee asked whether the fee change affects vesting or employer match timing for wages paid across the cutover. Also need to confirm any retro fee billing the vendor may apply and whether we should communicate to impacted employees.
patrick (Payroll): Dates please: fee effective date, cutover date, and the pay periods overlapping the change. Vendors usually don't touch vesting rules on a cutover; vesting is plan-doc driven. Fees might be billed to plan or participant depending on the plan.
zoe (People Ops): Fee effective 2025-07-01, cutover 2025-07-10, impacted paychecks 06/20 pay thru 07/25 pay. Employee noticed a line item on their statement.
sana (Finance): Vesting is determined by service/plan doc, so fee changes don't alter accrued vesting. If the fee was participant-borne and charged by the recordkeeper, the vendor should reconcile charges across the cutover. If the plan absorbs fees we may see a retro invoice. We'll need vendor invoice & fee policy.
julio (Engineering): So my employer match for July is safe? I had deferrals in June and July before cutover.
patrick (Payroll): Yes employer match eligibility is based on deferrals actually withheld and plan rules; payroll will remit match for eligible periods. If the vendor applied fees to participant accounts that reduce account balances, that doesn't change employer match math.
benefits-bot: Policy excerpt: "Vesting and employer match are governed by the plan document. Recordkeeper fee changes do not change vesting accruals. For cutover billing discrepancies, submit payroll export and vendor statement to payroll@redwood for reconciliation." <https://docs.redwood.com/benefits/401k-fees-cutover>
zoe (People Ops): Action items: I'll collect affected employee statements and forward to Patrick + Sana. Patrick  can you open a vendor reconciliation ticket and request a fee billing explanation and any retro invoice? Sana  confirm whether finance will absorb or route charges to plan/participants once vendor response in.
patrick (Payroll): Will open vendor ticket TKT-401K-FEE-2140 after docs posted. If vendor applied participant charges in error we'll request reversal; if plan-billed, finance will advise.
sana (Finance): We'll wait for the vendor response and then draft a short FAQ for impacted employees clarifying match/vesting unaffected and expected timelines for any reversals or invoices.
zoe (People Ops): Thanks all  I'll upload statements to the secure folder and tag you. Will draft comms after we get vendor reply.
